summary.title: SafeBlueprint Community Edition
summary.description: STRIDE threat model for the on-device web app, local pack loader, exports, self-host server and CI/CD supply chain. Keep in sync with THREAT_MODEL.md.

data.name: Visitor (browser user)
data.description: Developer, product owner or architect answering questions

data.name: SafeBlueprint web app (browser)
data.description: Static HTML/JS running fully on the device

threats.title: Script injection via answers or pack text
threats.description: User-supplied text rendered into the page or report could run script (XSS).
threats.mitigation: All user and pack text is set with textContent or escaped (esc()); no eval; CSP script-src 'self' with SRI on every script. Controls: OWASP-ASVS-5.3, CWE-79

threats.title: Answers leave the device
threats.description: Telemetry, analytics or third-party loads could send answers elsewhere.
threats.mitigation: No analytics or third-party loads; CSP default-src/connect-src 'self'; CI verify job and ZAP baseline check for outbound calls. Controls: APP1.7, APP11, OWASP-LLM02

threats.title: Look-alike or modified copy of the tool
threats.description: A tampered copy could collect data.
threats.mitigation: Signed releases, SLSA provenance and SBOM attestations; SHA256SUMS; SRI hashes. Controls: SLSA-L2, ASD-E8-APPCTRL

threats.title: Very large or deeply nested pack freezes the tab
threats.description: A crafted file could exhaust memory or CPU.
threats.mitigation: 1 MB file limit, 500 question limit, 2000 character cell limit; parser is linear with no recursion. Controls: CWE-400

data.name: Local file loader (question packs)
data.description: FileReader reads a CSV/JSON chosen by the user; validated against schema v1

threats.title: Malicious pack content (HTML, formulas, javascript: URLs)
threats.description: A shared pack could carry script, HTML or spreadsheet formulas.
threats.mitigation: Pack text only rendered via textContent; links are never created from pack data; strict field validation with row/column errors. Controls: CWE-79, CWE-1236

threats.title: Unclear which pack produced a report
threats.description: Reports could be produced with an altered pack.
threats.mitigation: Report document control shows pack name, version and SHA-256 of the exact file. Controls: ISO42001-7.5

threats.title: Pack loaded from another origin via config
threats.description: config.json questionPack could point to a remote pack.
threats.mitigation: Only same-site paths matching a strict pattern are fetched; CSP connect-src 'self'. Controls: CWE-918

data.name: Exports (PDF, HTML, JSON, Markdown, CSV)
data.description: Files saved to the user's device

threats.title: Formula injection in CSV exports
threats.description: Cells starting with = + - @ could run formulas in Excel.
threats.mitigation: formulaSafe() prefixes risky cells with an apostrophe. Controls: CWE-1236

threats.title: Saved reports contain sensitive answers
threats.description: Exported files may be shared beyond the intended audience.
threats.mitigation: Classification label on every page; user owns content; files never leave the device unless the user shares them. Controls: APP11, ISO42001-A.7 (Risk accepted.)

threats.title: Markdown/HTML injection in exported files
threats.description: User text could alter Markdown tables or HTML exports.
threats.mitigation: Markdown cells escape backslashes and pipes; HTML export serialises DOM built with textContent. Controls: CWE-116

data.name: Self-host server (nginx / static host)
data.description: Serves the static files on the customer's network

threats.title: Missing security headers
threats.description: Without CSP, HSTS, framing protection the site is easier to attack.
threats.mitigation: nginx.conf and site/_headers set CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/CORP. Controls: OWASP-ASVS-14.4, ASD-E8-HARDEN

threats.title: Modified files on the server
threats.description: An attacker or mistake changes the served files.
threats.mitigation: SHA256SUMS.txt and SRI; verify with sha256sum -c; container runs read-only static content. Controls: ASD-E8-APPCTRL

threats.title: Vulnerable base image
threats.description: nginx base image CVEs.
threats.mitigation: Image pinned by digest; Dependabot docker updates; Trivy scan on PR. Controls: ASD-E8-PATCH

threats.title: Compromised third-party action
threats.description: A malicious action version could alter releases or steal tokens.
threats.mitigation: All actions pinned to full SHAs; allowed-actions list; SHA pinning required; harden-runner egress audit; zizmor lint; read-only default token; release notes come only from the reviewed CHANGELOG.md on the signed tag, never from PR or issue input. Controls: SLSA-L2, OWASP-CICD-SEC-8

threats.title: Untrusted PR code with secrets
threats.description: Fork PRs could exfiltrate secrets.
threats.mitigation: No pull_request_target; persist-credentials false; fork workflow approval for external contributors; AI review only for same-repo PRs. Controls: OWASP-CICD-SEC-4

threats.title: Unverified commits or tags
threats.description: Forged commits or release tags.
threats.mitigation: Signed commits required on main; tag ruleset restricts v* to admins; provenance attestations. Controls: SLSA-L2

threats.title: Security-sensitive change without review
threats.description: Headers, workflows or loader change silently.
threats.mitigation: Threat-model gate (run from the base branch) classifies each PR by content; risk-relevant changes need a maintainer label applied after the latest push, with a drafted threat entry; a generated inventory of flows, endpoints, headers and workflow permissions must match the code (read-only CI, never pushes to PR branches); CODEOWNERS; 1 approval and conversation resolution. Controls: ISO42001-8.1

threats.title: Unreviewed code deployed to production
threats.description: A deploy could ship code that skipped review.
threats.mitigation: Deploy production only from signed vX.Y.Z tags on main (PR + required checks); production environment needs maintainer approval; secrets scoped to the environment; pinned wrangler-action; smoke tests after deploy; setup-node package cache disabled in the deploy job to prevent cache poisoning; production contact function accepts only the pages.dev origins (no localhost). Controls: SLSA-L2, OWASP-CICD-SEC-1

threats.title: T20d Approve-to-release tags and deploys an unapproved commit, or the release key is misused
threats.description: The approve-release workflow could tag or deploy a commit nobody approved, or its tag permission could be abused.
threats.mitigation: Runs from main only; read-only check job validates release files, allowed signers, free tag and verified main HEAD and records the SHA; only the production-environment job (maintainer approval) reads the RELEASE_DEPLOY_KEY environment secret, confirms approval and that the SHA is on main, SSH-signs the tag with a neutral identity, verifies it against .github/release-signers and pushes it over SSH with a pinned github.com host key; key in a temp 0600 file, never printed; job token read-only. The resulting push is skipped by the source job in release.yml and deploy.yml (no duplicate release or deploy). Called release and rollback verify the SSH signature against allowed signers. Approver and run URL recorded; provenance attestation kept. Residual: Deploy keys ruleset bypass; a stolen key could push a tag but cannot deploy without approval. Controls: SLSA-L2, OWASP-CICD-SEC-1, OWASP-CICD-SEC-5, OWASP-CICD-SEC-6

threats.title: Unreviewed or indexed staging deploy
threats.description: Merged code reaches the public staging URL without production approval, or staging is indexed and mistaken for production.
threats.mitigation: Staging is the first job of deploy.yml (own concurrency group, so a production deploy waiting for approval never blocks it), runs only on pushes to main (PR + required checks), signed v* tags or manual dispatch, and deploys only to the staging Pages branch alias (--branch staging), never production; same pinned actions, harden-runner, read-only permissions and disabled package cache as production; X-Robots-Tag noindex added to the staging build only; smoke tests after deploy. Production deploys only from verified release tags, after staging succeeds and a maintainer approves. Controls: SLSA-L2, OWASP-CICD-SEC-1

threats.title: PR preview leaks secrets or ships attacker code
threats.description: A PR deploy leaks the Cloudflare token or ships attacker code under the project domain.
threats.mitigation: preview.yml runs on pull_request only (never pull_request_target), only for same-repo heads and not Dependabot, so fork PRs never run it or get secrets; build step has no secrets; deploys only to a pr-<number> alias; noindex; token limited to contents:read, deployments and PR comments. Residual: write-access users can run code beside the token. Controls: OWASP-CICD-SEC-4, OWASP-CICD-SEC-6

threats.title: Forged or off-main release tag deployed
threats.description: An unsigned, forged or off-main tag is released or deployed, or a rollback changes main.
threats.mitigation: Production deploys only from vX.Y.Z tags; release, deploy-production and rollback verify via the GitHub API that the tag is annotated, GitHub-verified and on main; v* tag ruleset admin-only; tags signed locally by the maintainer (no CI signing key); maintainer-only Release gate; rollback is read-only on git, checks out the exact tag commit, verifies SHA256SUMS and needs production approval. Controls: SLSA-L2, OWASP-CICD-SEC-1, OWASP-CICD-SEC-9

threats.title: Release zip differs from the reviewed source
threats.description: A compromised or non-deterministic release build could ship files that do not match the tagged commit.
threats.mitigation: scripts/build-release.sh builds from the git tree only (git archive) with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH from the commit time, sorted entries, fixed 0644/0755 permissions and no extra attributes; the reproducible-build check builds twice and compares hashes on every PR; the release job rebuilds and fails if the two builds differ; anyone can rebuild and compare with SHA256SUMS (docs/VERIFY.md). Controls: SLSA-L2 (reproducible build), OWASP-CICD-SEC-9

threats.title: Secrets committed
threats.description: Keys pushed to the repo.
threats.mitigation: Secret scanning with push protection; Gitleaks full-history scan. Controls: CWE-798

data.name: Contact function (hosted only)
data.description: Cloudflare Pages Function relaying consented contact requests via Resend

threats.title: Contact details sent to a third party or leaked in logs
threats.description: Contact form data could go to an unintended service or appear in logs.
threats.mitigation: Resend only; recipient and key from Pages env (CONTACT_TO, RESEND_API_KEY); 503 when unset; origin allow-list; strict field limits; emails redacted in logs; self-host edition has no function. Controls: APP11, OWASP-ASVS-14.4
